mapper.sql: SUPPLIER_ID, SUPPLIER_CODE, SUPPLIER_NAME, SUPPLIER_CATEGORY, SUPPLIER_STATUS, CREDIT_CODE, LEGAL_REPRESENTATIVE, REGISTERED_ADDRESS, CONTACT_PERSON, CONTACT_PHONE, CONTACT_EMAIL, FAX_NUMBER, CONTACT_ADDRESS, BANK_NAME, BANK_ACCOUNT, CREDIT_LEVEL, CREDIT_LIMIT, PAYMENT_METHOD, PAYMENT_TERMS, REMARKS, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_BY
mapper.select: SELECT s.SUPPLIER_ID, s.SUPPLIER_CODE, s.SUPPLIER_NAME, s.SUPPLIER_CATEGORY, s.SUPPLIER_STATUS, s.CREDIT_CODE, s.LEGAL_REPRESENTATIVE, s.REGISTERED_ADDRESS, s.CONTACT_PERSON, s.CONTACT_PHONE, s.CONTACT_EMAIL, s.FAX_NUMBER, s.CONTACT_ADDRESS, s.BANK_NAME, s.BANK_ACCOUNT, s.CREDIT_LEVEL, s.CREDIT_LIMIT, s.PAYMENT_METHOD, s.PAYMENT_TERMS, s.REMARKS, s.CREATE_TIME, s.CREATE_BY, CASE s.SUPPLIER_CATEGORY WHEN 1 THEN '原材料供应商' WHEN 2 THEN '设备供应商' WHEN 3 THEN '服务供应商' WHEN 4 THEN '其他供应商' ELSE '未知分类' END AS SUPPLIER_CATEGORY_NAME, CASE s.SUPPLIER_STATUS WHEN 1 THEN '正常' WHEN 2 THEN '暂停' WHEN 3 THEN '黑名单' ELSE '未知状态' END AS SUPPLIER_STATUS_NAME, CASE s.PAYMENT_METHOD WHEN 1 THEN '现金' WHEN 2 THEN '银行转账' WHEN 3 THEN '支票' WHEN 4 THEN '承兑汇票' ELSE '未知方式' END AS PAYMENT_METHOD_NAME FROM TBL_SUPPLIER s WHERE s.SUPPLIER_ID = #{supplierId} AND s.IS_DELETED = 0
SELECT * FROM TBL_SUPPLIER WHERE SUPPLIER_CODE = #{supplierCode} AND IS_DELETED = 0
SELECT * FROM TBL_SUPPLIER WHERE SUPPLIER_ID = #{supplierId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
SELECT FROM TBL_SUPPLIER WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND SUPPLIER_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY SUPPLIER_CODE ASC

SELECT SUPPLIER_ID, SUPPLIER_CODE, SUPPLIER_NAME FROM TBL_SUPPLIER WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND SUPPLIER_STATUS = 1
AND (SUPPLIER_CODE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR SUPPLIER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY SUPPLIER_CODE ASC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_SUPPLIER ( SUPPLIER_ID, SUPPLIER_CODE, SUPPLIER_NAME, SUPPLIER_CATEGORY, SUPPLIER_STATUS, CREDIT_CODE, LEGAL_REPRESENTATIVE, REGISTERED_ADDRESS, CONTACT_PERSON, CONTACT_PHONE, CONTACT_EMAIL, FAX_NUMBER, CONTACT_ADDRESS, BANK_NAME, BANK_ACCOUNT, CREDIT_LEVEL, CREDIT_LIMIT, PAYMENT_METHOD, PAYMENT_TERMS, REMARKS, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, TENANT_ID, IS_DELETED ) VALUES ( #{supplierId}, #{supplierCode}, #{supplierName}, #{supplierCategory}, #{supplierStatus}, #{creditCode}, #{legalRepresentative}, #{registeredAddress}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{faxNumber}, #{contactAddress}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccount}, #{creditLevel}, #{creditLimit}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentTerms}, #{remarks}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{tenantId}, #{isDeleted} )
